name: /dev/null
author: ivo
description: Read-only dev-null.sh commit feed for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Merged commit log from the dev-null.sh developers you watch.

schema.label: Feed
schema.description: Following is this plugin's watchlist, merged from the public API. Latest and Trending are read from the site's own log pages.

schema.label: Watched GitHub usernames
schema.description: Comma separated. dev-null.sh publishes no global timeline endpoint, so the feed is the merged commit log of these users.

schema.label: Include replies
schema.description: Fetch each user's replies as well as their top-level commits. The API keeps them in two lists, so this costs a second request per watched user.

schema.label: Refresh (minutes)
schema.description: The public API allows 60 requests per minute per IP; one refresh costs one request per watched user, two when replies are included.

schema.label: Notify on new posts
schema.description: A desktop notification when a developer you watch posts on the Following feed. Skipped while the panel is open, and one notification per batch rather than one per commit.

schema.label: Sound on new posts
schema.description: Play a sound with that notification, through the sound theme you have active. Silenced by Do Not Disturb together with the notification itself. No effect when "Notify on new posts" is off.
